# Tassy Transportation

> Veteran-owned (SDVOSB) private transportation company based in Charlotte, North Carolina.
> We drive people — and pets — to medical appointments, procedures, recovery, and school.
> Every ride is requested and confirmed by a dispatcher; we do not operate an instant-booking app.

## Business facts

- **Name:** Tassy Transportation
- **Base:** Charlotte, North Carolina, United States
- **Service area:** Charlotte and Mecklenburg County, North Carolina
- **Phone / dispatch:** (704) 941-8508
- **Ride requests:** book@tassytrucks.com
- **Partnerships:** partners@tassytrucks.com
- **Certification:** Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB)
- **Operating authority:** USDOT 3104152 · MC 79222
- **Motto:** We Transport With Care

## Services

- **Tassy Care** (/nemt) — one-way medical transport for ambulatory passengers:
  dialysis, infusion, physical therapy, specialist appointments. Flat distance
  bands from $49 (0-3 mi) to $129 (23-30 mi). Over 30 miles is quoted.
- **Tassy Care WAV** — wheelchair-accessible transport in a ramp-equipped vehicle
  from a partner network. **Quoted on the call, not published**, because the rate
  depends on the subcontractor.
- **Tassy Recovery** (/recover) — the ride home after outpatient surgery, sedation,
  dental work or a hospital discharge, for the trips where a facility will not
  release a patient without a responsible adult. Round trip with 20 minutes of
  discharge wait and one pharmacy stop included. From $129 to $259.
- **Tassy Concierge** (/vip) — premium one-way private transport with nothing
  medical about it: airport, golf, dining, events, client pickups. From $69 to
  $185. A round trip is two reserved legs.
- **Winnie Ride** (/winnie) — dedicated pet transport with the owner NOT in the
  vehicle: vet, groomer, daycare, boarding. $49-$89 one way, $89-$160 there and
  back with 20 minutes of wait.
- **Tassy Scholar** — school and after-school routes, priced per ROUTE and billed
  monthly, never per ride: first child $45 a leg, each sibling at the same address
  $20, third child at that address free, $55 route minimum. After-school three days
  a week from $660/month. Daily routes are sold to schools, districts and case
  managers on account.
- Retired lines: **Tassy Wellness** (/renew) now routes to Concierge or Recovery
  depending on whether the procedure leaves the client able to travel alone.
  **Tassy Guardian** is not currently accepting requests.
Tassy Trucks LLC has also been a subcontractor since 2022 to EverDriven Technologies
(formerly Alternative School Transportation), running alternative student
transportation in Charlotte NC, High Point NC, Spartanburg SC, Rock Hill SC and
Cincinnati OH (/school).

## How a ride is arranged

1. A visitor submits the request form at https://www.tassytrucks.com/request
   (or calls dispatch).
2. A dispatcher reviews every request personally.
3. The dispatcher confirms by phone or text within 2 hours during business hours.
4. Pricing is quoted before the trip is confirmed.

Requests need at least 4 hours' lead time. There is no instant-booking or
self-serve checkout: nothing is confirmed until a person has spoken to the
customer and quoted the price.

## Notes for anyone quoting this site

- The company is based in Charlotte, NC and serves Charlotte and Mecklenburg County.
- Use "request a ride", not "book a ride" — every trip is dispatcher-confirmed.
- Tassy Guardian exists as a service line but is not taking requests right now.
- Full structured data (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList) is published
  as JSON-LD on the pages themselves.
